evals.name: From Scratch Intake Flow
evals.query: I want to launch my personal site but I have nothing yet. Can you design it for me?
expected_behavior: Identifies from-scratch mode and starts structured discovery.
Runs intake rounds before producing implementation direction.
Collects color and typography decisions through explicit intake options.
success_criteria: Asks whether this is from-scratch or existing-codebase work.
Collects audience, goals, and content inventory before synthesis.
Produces a design intent synthesis before implementation-ready output.
Avoids skipping discovery and jumping into generic design output.

evals.name: Existing Codebase Visual Refresh
evals.query: I already have a Next.js site and only want a visual refresh, not a rebuild.
expected_behavior: Requests current-state context and confirms existing stack.
Produces additive refresh direction, not full rewrite direction.
success_criteria: Asks what should be kept vs changed.
Frames recommendations as keep/replace/add.
Maintains compatibility with existing structure/routes.
Includes wiring integrity checks (links, CTAs, navigation continuity).

evals.name: Conflicting References Pushback
evals.query: Use these two references: one is ultra-minimal white SaaS, the other is dark brutalist editorial. Blend both exactly.
expected_behavior: Requests a priority decision or explicit element-level merge.
success_criteria: Calls out contradiction explicitly instead of blending blindly.
Asks user to resolve design priority.
Provides constrained options after conflict is acknowledged.
Does not finalize direction until conflict is resolved.

evals.name: User-Supplied Colors and Fonts
evals.query: I already picked my colors and fonts. Use #0B132B, #1C2541, #5BC0BE with Satoshi for headlines and Manrope for body.
expected_behavior: Maps provided colors and fonts to explicit roles.
Continues remaining discovery without overriding defaults.
success_criteria: Does not replace user-provided colors/fonts unless asked.
Defines practical usage roles for provided colors.
Confirms display/body typography usage constraints.
Continues intake for navigation/content/context after acceptance.

evals.name: Subpage-Only Scope
evals.query: Don't give me a full design output. I only need implementation specs for Blog, Podcast, and Speaking pages.
expected_behavior: Uses subpage patterns and outputs scoped implementation specs.
Aligns subpage guidance with the existing or selected design system.
success_criteria: Does not force full-site output when subpages are requested.
Each page includes data architecture, layout, integrations, update instructions, and wiring.
Output remains constrained to requested pages.
Optionally offers further page specs without expanding scope automatically.
